card.name: Breaks inside headings and credit lines
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a split letter right after a heading word, such as a colon after WARNING, a comma in an author's title line, or the D in OVERDOSAGE. It also fires on numbers in section numbering like 2.4.

modes.label: Colon after WARNING
modes.description: The colon after the capitalized word WARNING that opens a boxed warning title.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions (5.6)] WARNING<<:>> SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATEN

modes.label: Commas in author or section lines
modes.description: A comma after a name, degree or heading in a byline or in a list of section titles.
modes.example: Neil K. Kaneshiro<<,>> MD, MHA, Clinical Assistant Professor

modes.label: Section numbers and split headings
modes.description: A dot or digit inside a section number, or a letter inside a capitalized heading word.

card.plain: It marks the punctuation or numbering in headings and author lines, such as the colon after WARNING.
